secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Resend API key so contact-form messages are emailed to you. Create one at https://resend.com/api-keys. Without it messages are still stored in data/messages.jsonl.

secrets.name: CONTACT_TO_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. The inbox that receives contact-form messages (e.g. you@yourdomain.com).

secrets.name: CONTACT_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. Verified sender for outgoing mail, e.g. 'Portfolio <hello@yourdomain.com>'. Defaults to Resend's onboarding sender.
